brief: Tries changes on a copy of an org chart and reports the average span and vacancy rate before and after.
detail: The copy holds the records of the original (positions, people, departments) but no graph nodes, so a change_reporting change raises today. The original chart is never touched.
receiver: oc = new stzOrgChart("TechCo"); oc.AddExecutiveXT("ceo", "CEO"); oc.AddManagerXT("vp", "VP Sales"); oc.ReportsTo("vp", "ceo"); oc.AddPersonXT("p1", "Alice"); oc.AssignPerson("p1", "ceo"); o1 = new stzOrgChartSimulation(oc)
